{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}{f7:0080}Bandit:{n}{f7:0380}{n}Heh heh heh heh, what's a drunk doin' here?!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Stop your fussing. It's going straight to my hangover!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}{name:0180} defeated the bandit.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}You really are a stiff one. Perhaps you ought to learn to relax a little.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes, I'm tired indeed. ...And are you saying you'll ease this weariness of mine?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. Traveling is most enjoyable. Thanks to the lovely ladies I meet wherever I go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}What a busybody. I know my own body well enough. Without you telling me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Same as always, without you needing to ask.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}Needless worry. There's nothing wrong.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Oh? You say some rather good things.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I like walking outside too. Being close to nature soothes the heart.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I wasn't particularly hoping to see you...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Hmph. You show up out of nowhere, and this is what you ask...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not especially hungry, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...Will that do?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. It has been a while. You seem the same as ever.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you seen any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...You show up out of nowhere, and that's what you ask?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}As it happens, I've come across beautiful scenery many times, but what an odd question.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did my sudden visit startle you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}No. You always do, don't you? If I were startled every time you appeared out of nowhere, I'd never survive.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}And so you came all this way to check on me? How dutiful. Earnest, or meddlesome...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Well? Do you sense anything unusual?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If I can do anything, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Sorry, but I'll decline for now. I don't care to rely on others much.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might be lost.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Good grief, how rude. To think you took me for a lost child.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How do you feel about becoming a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}A hero... hm.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I'm to fight as a hero, I'd at least rather not do anything that would tarnish my name...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do even nobles have hardships?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Naturally, plenty. They're especially fussy about pointless customs. It's tiresome.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yes. Traveling is most enjoyable. Thanks to the lovely ladies I meet wherever I go.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}Hmph. You show up out of nowhere, and this is what you ask...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm not especially hungry, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Will that do?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}That's enough now, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}That's none of your concern, is it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You disturb a man's sleep and then have the nerve to say that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0380}{n}...An utter nuisance. I'd like you to leave at once.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}I see... That's all very well, but spare me the trouble your uninvited worries cause.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}It's not that... Sorry, but I want to sleep early tonight.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}...Good grief. I know that much without being told.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry. I'll leave right away.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...For today, I'd appreciate that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It seems I came at the wrong time.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}The wrong time?! Hmph, spare me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Still, it's very like you. Oddly convincing.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}That's none of your concern, is it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You disturb a man's sleep and then have the nerve to say that.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0580}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that all? Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
